name: Community — MOSS-Image Finetunes
author: toya_san / catlover1937 / lodestones / malcolmrey / lonecatone23 / nuko_masshigura (pack: michaeldune)
description: Six MOSS-Image finetunes, each tested side by side against the MOSS-Image pack. Sam_MOSS Turbo (Civitai): natural-looking pictures in 8 steps, about 12 seconds on a 12 GB card. Moody Moss Mix (Civitai): deeper contrast and richer colour, 25 steps, about 27 seconds. Kromoss Turbo (lodestones, since 1.1.0): a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base with an 8-step LoRA, about 4 seconds, more variety and more literal layouts, but less reliable small lettering. Since 1.2.0, three the community asked for: Moss Serenity (brighter and flatter, about 23 seconds), AniMOSSity (deepest colour and contrast, bf16 only, about 53 seconds) and MOSS Cat Tower (the most polished anime, 50 steps with Skip Layer Guidance, about 34 seconds, engine v0.43.0 or later). Put every word you want on the picture in quotes. They share the MOSS-Image text encoder and autoencoder, so each card adds only its own 5-10 GB if you already have the MOSS-Image pack. Like that pack, it needs a SimpliGen engine with MOSS-Image support, which today means the beta engine (Settings > Updates > beta).

presets.name: Sam_MOSS Turbo
presets.description:
Natural-looking pictures with the speed built in: toya_san's MOSS-Image finetune needs no speed LoRA and takes about 12 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

Skin and light look natural rather than retouched, and it keeps the light and mood you ask for, so it suits portraits and photo-style prompts better than MOSS-Image Fast.

Put every word you want on the picture in quotes. Lettering is good, but it can still drop a word from a small label now and then, so check signs and buttons.

Model format: int8.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3008366 (Sam_MOSS by toya_san), version 3416093 'Turbo v2.0', file samMOSS_turboV20.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit, Rent, Sell, SellMerge. Author settings: er_sde / simple, 8 steps, CFG 1. Measured ~12 s per picture across changing prompts. Against our cards: the most natural skin of the fast models tested, kept the dawn light in the fisherman test; one slip on 9 prompts ('17 Pro' without 'iPhone' on a small card). Rejected in the same test: Moss Image Turbo and Artius Moss (one family, retouched skin, weaker prompt following), Mosaic (paid access). Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts (six posters, three photos), seed 11.

presets.name: Moody Moss Mix
presets.tagline: MOSS-Image with deeper contrast and richer colour
presets.description:
MOSS-Image with more contrast and saturation: darker shadows, richer colour, and a painterly look when you ask for illustration. By catlover1937.

Lettering stays exact. Put every word you want on the picture in quotes.

About 27 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. Pick it for a punchier look; for a neutral one, use MOSS-Image.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

presets.name: Kromoss Turbo
presets.tagline: Photographic MOSS in 8 steps, with more variety per seed
presets.description:
A full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base by lodestones, with its own 8-step speed LoRA: about 4 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

It follows layout and composition directions more literally than MOSS-Image and gives much more variety between seeds. Photos look natural rather than retouched, and posters can come out looking like real printed paper.

Lettering: big headlines in quotes come out right, but small signs and thin fonts can lose or garble a word. For text that must be exact, use MOSS-Image.

Ask for a "woman" or "man" and give an age. With "girl" it draws teenagers, and people can look younger than with MOSS-Image even then.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

requirements.notes: lodestones/Kromoss pinned to commit 7f9bb7b0 (2026-10-20, update 11000 EMA, Apache-2.0): kromoss_int8_convrot.safetensors (ConvRot W8A8 like Comfy-Org's SFT int8, 5.41 GB) and 8-steps-dmd2-lora (DMD then DMD2's GAN stage, distilled from MOSS-Image-Base, rank 128, 1.19 GB, saved as kromoss_8step_dmd2_lora.safetensors), both sha256 pinned. Author settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple, no negative branch. TESTED 2026-10-20 engine-direct on nine prompts at seed 11 and four prompts at seeds 7, 11 and 42 against both MOSS-Image cards (F:/Claude-Work/kromoss-20261020): ~4 s per picture; composition followed the prompt 6/6 where the MOSS cards did about half; a 1970s poster's shop sign lost or garbled a word on 3 of 6 renders (MOSS cards 5/6 right); 'photo of a girl' drew teenagers, 'woman' gave adults on 2 of 3 seeds. The author's small FLUX.2 decoder was not used; the shared Flux 2 VAE works. Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts (six posters, three photos), seed 11. Kromoss was trained on 704,000 pictures.

presets.name: Moss Serenity v1.0
presets.tagline: Brighter, flatter MOSS-Image with looser lettering
presets.description:
A brighter, flatter take on MOSS-Image, with looser, more calligraphic poster lettering. It is malcolmrey's true finetune with no LoRAs merged in, a snapshot at 210,000 training steps that the author plans to train further.

Put every word you want in quotes, and check your text: a figure can cover a word on a sign. It reads semi-real rather than anime when you ask for anime.

25 steps at CFG 3 (the author gives no settings), about 23 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

presets.name: AniMOSSity v1.0 (bf16)
presets.tagline: Deepest colour and contrast of the MOSS cards; slow
presets.description:
Anime meets realism, with a lot of colour: in our test it had the deepest colour and contrast of the MOSS cards and kept lettering good. By lonecatone23, the MOSS-Image version of their Animosity, trained on its own images rather than merged.

It only comes as a 10 GB bf16 file, so it is the slow one here: about 53 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. 25 steps at CFG 3 (the author gives no settings).

Put every word you want in quotes. Please credit lonecatone23 when you share what you make.

Model format: bf16, not quantized.

presets.name: MOSS Cat Tower v1.0
presets.tagline: The most polished anime on MOSS-Image, 50 steps
presets.description:
The most polished anime of the MOSS cards in our test. It is nuko_masshigura's merge of full MOSS-Image finetunes, tuned for anime.

It runs the author's recipe: 50 steps at CFG 3 with Skip Layer Guidance. The author says the art style and bodies suffer without that guidance. In our test it changed the pictures a little and cost no extra time: about 34 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

The author trained it on natural-language captions and Danbooru tags, so either kind of prompt works. Put every word you want in quotes.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
